name: lalin-workspace
description: Root workspace orchestration for the Lalin AI audio workstation.

scripts.build:node: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:desktop
scripts.check:api: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$candidates = 'apps/api/.venv/Scripts/python.exe','apps/api/.venv-ci/Scripts/python.exe','backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe'; $py = $candidates | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $py) { Write-Host \"[!] No venv found (checked: $($candidates -join ', '))\"; exit 1 }; & $py -m compileall -q apps/api/app"
scripts.check:all: npm run build:node && npm run check:api && npm run check:tauri
